verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform, since a provider could open-source its stack, CLI or tooling. Nothing in the pack shows Lambda publishing its own source under an open license. The preinstalled Lambda Stack frameworks and the unofficial third-party CLI/MCP server are not Lambda's own open-licensed source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
